parsed.explanation: No criminalisation (decriminalised 2005), no documented trans-specific violence or police targeting, and a 2019 Gender Equality Act covering gender identity across goods/services — a protection a visitor could invoke. Institutions appear functional: judicial conduct rules, HRC membership, an open LGBTIQ initiative operating publicly. No facility, border or custody exposure is documented, and absence of hostility here sits within a generally positive record rather than a silent thin dossier. Deductions: the record is thin on visitor-specific evidence (document handling, ward/custody placement, care access remain open questions), enforcement of the 2019 Act is untested in the dossier, same-sex marriage non-recognition signals residual conservatism, and acceptance evidence is limited. Nothing reaches tier 1-2; this is reduced risk with real but incomplete protection.
